Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning personal financial affairs reporting by public hospital district officials.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to personal financial affairs reporting by publichospital district officials; and amending RCW 42.17A.705.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:
